name: @nube/starter-ext-sdk-ts
description: What UI extension authors import. Forked from rubix-workspace/extension-ui-sdk main entry, with rubix graph hooks (useNode/useSlot/useKinds) stripped — those are rubix-specific. Provides useHostClient (typed wrapper over @nube/starter-client-ts; UI extensions never raw fetch per SCOPE R11), BlockShell, useSlotContext, registerExtensionContributions.
